raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

TileLang SparseMLA (`sglang::tilelang_sparse_fwd`) was already mapped in the perf model, but it was still treated as dense full-context MLA, so GLM-5.3 decode with a huge generation KV length produced absurd roofline numbers (~87 TB/s and ~1815 MiB moved). This PR reads the sparse topk from the indices tensor (`Input Dims[2][-1]`), sets it as `sliding_window`, and lets existing `_cap_gen_kv` cap generation KV to that topk so bytes and bandwidth stay in a realistic range.

## Summary

TileLang SparseMLA (`sglang::tilelang_sparse_fwd`) was already mapped in the perf model, but it was still treated as dense full-context MLA, so GLM-5.3 decode with a huge generation KV length produced absurd roofline numbers (~87 TB/s and ~1815 MiB moved). This PR reads the sparse topk from the indices tensor (`Input Dims[2][-1]`), sets it as `sliding_window`, and lets existing `_cap_gen_kv` cap generation KV to that topk so bytes and bandwidth stay in a realistic range.
detail.title: fix(perf-model): cap TileLang SparseMLA KV to indices topk

files.patch:
@@ -711,6 +711,13 @@ def get_param_details(event):
 
 
 class mla_tilelang_sparse_fwd(InferenceAttention):
+    """
+    Performance model for ``sglang::tilelang_sparse_fwd`` (TileLang SparseMLA;
+    inference: sglang).
+
+    Indices topk from ``Input Dims[2][-1]`` → ``sliding_window`` /
+    :meth:`InferenceAttention._cap_gen_kv`.
+    """
 
     @staticmethod
     def get_param_details(event):
@@ -722,6 +729,14 @@ def get_param_details(event):
             params["d_h_v"] = 512
         else:
             params["d_h_v"] = int(concrete[4])
+        args = event.get("args") or {}
+        dims = args.get("Input Dims") or []
+        if len(dims) <= 2 or len(dims[2]) < 1:
+            return InferenceAttention.no_perf_param_details()
+        topk = int(dims[2][-1])
+        if topk <= 0:
+            return InferenceAttention.no_perf_param_details()
+        params["sliding_window"] = topk
         return params

@@ -1787,6 +1787,54 @@ def test_pa_decode_gluon(self):
         model = pa_decode_gluon(event)
         assert model.flops() > 0
 
+    def test_mla_tilelang_sparse_fwd_topk_sliding_window(self):
+        event = {
+            "annotation": (
+                "execute_11_context_0(sq0sk0sqsq0sqsk0)"
+                "_generation_11(sq11sk1749268sqsq11sqsk1749268)"
+            ),
+            "args": {
+                "Input Dims": [[12, 8, 576], [2991488, 1, 576], [12, 1, 2048]],
+                "Input type": ["c10::Float8_e4m3fn", "c10::Float8_e4m3fn", "int"],
+            },
+        }
+        model = mla_tilelang_sparse_fwd(event)
+        assert model.param_details["sliding_window"] == 2048
+        assert model.param_details["d_h_v"] == 512
+        capped = 11 * 2048
+        assert model._cap_gen_kv(model.param_details["g_sk"]) == capped
+        assert model._cap_gen_kv(model.param_details["g_sqsk"]) == capped
+        bytes_mib = model.bytes() / (1024**2)
+        assert bytes_mib < 1815
+        assert 20 <= bytes_mib <= 30
+        duration_s = 21.81e-6
+        tb_per_s = model.bytes() / duration_s / 1e12
+        assert tb_per_s < 7.4
+        assert 0.5 <= tb_per_s <= 2.0
+
+    def test_mla_tilelang_sparse_fwd_missing_indices_no_perf(self):
+        base = {
+            "annotation": (
+                "execute_11_context_0(sq0sk0sqsq0sqsk0)"
+                "_generation_11(sq11sk1749268sqsq11sqsk1749268)"
+            ),
+        }
+        for dims in (
+            [[12, 8, 576], [2991488, 1, 576]],
+            [[12, 8, 576], [2991488, 1, 576], []],
+            [[12, 8, 576], [2991488, 1, 576], [12, 1, 0]],
+        ):
+            event = {
+                **base,
+                "args": {
+                    "Input Dims": dims,
+                    "Input type": ["c10::Float8_e4m3fn", "c10::Float8_e4m3fn", "int"],
+                },
+            }
+            model = mla_tilelang_sparse_fwd(event)
+            assert model.param_details.get("_no_perf")
+            assert model.flops() is None
+
     def test_inference_attention_no_perf(self):
         model = InferenceAttention({"annotation": "bad", "args": {}})
         assert model.flops() is None
